summary: Frontend-only landing page (Mojtaba Mousavi designer portfolio) tested end-to-end. All 13 acceptance criteria pass: hero headline, sticky nav with 6 links, theme toggle persisting html.dark class, resume PDF (200, 83KB application/pdf), 7 work items by data-testid, 4 values, 4 testimonials, accolades & press, contact with email, footer copyright, and mobile menu open/close. 0 console errors, 0 page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js section ordering puts <Work /> before <Values />, but the brief lists Hero -> Values -> Work -> Testimonials. Current order works (anchors still resolve) but doesn't match the description in the original problem statement; consider reviewing whether the on-page order should mirror the navigation order (Intro, Work, Values, References, Press, Contact) - actually current order DOES match navigation, so this is fine. No action required.
Navigation hides the Resume button below sm breakpoint and exposes a separate mobile-download-resume link in the panel - good UX. data-testid coverage is excellent across all interactive elements.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static frontend-only portfolio site at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Theme toggle correctly flips html.dark class. Resume PDF returns 200 OK with content-type application/pdf and 83163 bytes. No backend changes were touched.
